title: Big Buck Bunny
announcement: Big Buck Bunny. Family comedy, 2008, 10 minutes. 50 descriptions.

cues.text: A vast, soft pink cloud dominates the sky above a line of green trees, with a faint bird silhouette visible against the pale horizon.
A serene stream flows through vibrant grass and flowers.
A small purple owl perches on a branch.
A large tree with moss-covered roots and a dark hollow stands in a sunlit meadow, surrounded by vibrant green grass dotted with small purple flowers and scattered rocks.
A large grey rabbit stretches contentedly near a mossy tree root.
A fluffy white rabbit looks up at a bright blue sky.
The fluffy white rabbit, previously stretching, now looks up with one eye open, smiling gently under a bright blue sky.
A large white rabbit stretches in a grassy field.
The fluffy white rabbit smiles gently, one eye open.

The white rabbit lifts its paws toward the purple butterfly hovering above.
A red squirrel with wide eyes stands beside a grey chinchilla holding an acorn, as a third squirrel approaches.
The white rabbit, seated by a tree, watches a purple butterfly hover above its head, now slightly lower in the air.
The white rabbit sits curled on the grass, near a leafy bush, motionless under bright sunlight.
The white rabbit stands in a sunlit field, looking upward with wide eyes.

Three small animals peek from behind a rock.

A close-up of a brown animated rabbit with wide eyes and protruding teeth.

A dark bird soars above the forest canopy against a clear blue sky.
A small, brown and white animated squirrel with large, wide eyes stands on rocky ground near a massive tree trunk, its tail curled upward.

The white rabbit’s face fills the frame, eyes wide and mouth slightly upturned.
The brown squirrel’s wide eyes fill the frame.
